[h2][HENTAI Plan] The Lustful Inn of Female Adventurers is now on sale![/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3461630

[h2]🏨 Introduction🏨[/h2]
✨ As the owner, build the ultimate inn!
💎 Increase satisfaction, customer appeal, and reputation to attract more guests and expand your inn’s facilities!
🎲 Experience tons of random events in your daily management, keeping the gameplay fresh every time!
⚔️ Take on monster-hunting quests to earn funds for your inn! Enjoy it as a full-fledged battle game too!
💕 Countless naughty encounters with the female adventurers staying at your inn 💕
👑 As your inn grows, a variety of female adventurers will come to stay!
🌟 Deepen your bonds with them—go on monster hunts together or enjoy some steamy moments...
💗 11 female adventurers available for naughty scenes! 53 total H-scenes with 5 scenes per character on average! Over 160 CGs and a scenario volume about 3 times larger than the previous game Dungeon Desire!
💘 Pure love-focused H-scenes! This time, we’ve emphasized character differentiation, tailoring diverse H-scenes to each character’s appearance and personality!

[h2]📋 Game Specs & Details 📋[/h2]
🎮 Game Genre
Inn Management Simulation RPG

💓 H-Scene Details  
[list]
[*] H-Compatible Female Characters: 11  
[*] H-Scenes: 53（160+ HCGs）  
[*] Voice: Voiced H-scenes  
[*] Screen Size: 1280x720
[/list]
⏱️ Estimated Playtime
Over 10 hours

[h2]🛠️ Convenient Systems 🛠️[/h2]
[list][*]🔄 Event Replay Mode: 
Revisit viewed H-scenes and CGs anytime, with an option to unlock all unviewed events.
[*]🤖 Auto-Battle Mode: 
For players who find combat tedious or want to save time, a high-performance AI auto-battle system is included.
[*]🌈 Cheat Mode: 
For those who find battle content bothersome, features like auto-completing monster-hunting quests are available.[/list]

[h2]Please don't forget to follow us on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/hentaiplan/]our Steam Publisher page[/url] to get the latest information!

[h2][HENTAI Plan] The Ring Of Succubus Queen will be released!
Don't forget to add this game to your wishlist![/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3725550

[h2]🎮STORY[/h2]
The seal is broken, revealing the hidden castle of the Succubus Queen in the desert.
Adventurers from all over rush toward the desert castle, seeking the Succubus Queen's buried treasure.
As various adventurers head for the treasure, the player takes on the role of a futanari imp—a lust demon—fighting humans to protect the treasure of their master, the Succubus Queen Mardic.


[h2]🕹GAME[/h2]
Control the imp and defeat enemies aiming for the Succubus Queen's treasure! 
Use direct attacks, magic, and even masturbation-based semen attacks! 
Defeat enemies to punish them! But beware—enemies will also target the imp's body!?

[h2]✨FEATURES[/h2]
[list]
[*] 2D side-scrolling action game combining magic and combat elements.
[*] Hand-drawn 2D animation for smooth character motion, vividly depicting both battles and H-scenes.
[*] After losing to enemies, specific events and animations can be viewed in a memory/replay mode.
[*] Multiple difficulty levels are available, including an Easy mode suitable for beginners.
[/list]

[h2][HENTAI Plan] Corporate Slave Succubus will be released!
Don't forget to add this game to your wishlist![/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3658820

[h2]🎮STORY[/h2]
In a world where humans, magic, and mana coexist—
Saki, originally human, suddenly finds herself transformed into a succubus.
Widely viewed by society as lustful and indecent beings, succubi face harsh discrimination.

Saki’s previously secured job offer is rescinded, plunging her into a difficult daily life.
Eventually, she manages to land a position at the "Succubus Primary Industry," finally starting her new career.
But her joy is short-lived.

She learns that failing to meet performance quotas will result in forced transfer to an "external branch," infamous for its hellish working conditions!?
In this succubus-themed company set against a modern backdrop, rookie succubus Saki struggles to survive—

Welcome to the Black Company Survival Simulation!

[h2]🕹GAME[/h2]
To fulfill her company's energy quotas, players control Saki as she "services" various customers.
Yes, by "service," we mean exactly what you think.

However, as a former human, Saki is inexperienced and clumsy, lacking the necessary seductive skills.
Thus, she must undertake various tasks to gather resources—mana and experience—and continuously develop herself.

By learning diverse skills and managing her daily schedule wisely, Saki’s available tasks expand gradually, and she can handle more demanding clients.
Naturally, new erotic events unlock accordingly!

Help Saki acquire new skills and carefully plan her schedule each day, guiding her growth into both a successful corporate slave and a talented succubus!

[h2]✨FEATURES[/h2]
[list]
[*] 📷34 Base CGs, with 578 variations.
[*] 🔓Over 44 diverse erotic scenarios.
[*] 🔁Multiple endings depending on your performance throughout one in-game year.
[*] 🕒Total playtime approx. 7 hours.
[*] 🎁Unlock-all-content switch included.
[/list]
